generated_for: ChatGPT plugin submission package (Path A, Phase 1). Kept in agreement with src/lib/mcp/chatgpt-profile.ts by chatgpt-profile.unit.test.ts.
platform_side_effects_note: Every call writes platform bookkeeping that is not a user-requested state change: a credit debit on the caller's existing balance (debit-on-success only, never on a refusal or a degraded empty result), a usage/call-log row, a search-history row for search-shaped arguments, and response-cache fills (sam_api_cache, mcp_external_cache, KV query cache) plus a rate-limit counter for warehouse lookups. None of these changes anything the user can see or act on in the external world, and repeating a call has the same effect on the user's data (none). No tool on this surface creates, edits, sends, deletes or publishes anything.

hint_rules.readOnlyHint: true for all 15: no tool writes to a user-visible business record or any external system.
hint_rules.destructiveHint: false for all 15: nothing is overwritten or deleted.
hint_rules.idempotentHint: true for all 15: the same arguments ask the same question; repeated calls have no additional effect on the user's data (results may change only because the underlying public data changed).
hint_rules.openWorldHint: true when the tool can make a live call to an external system (SAM.gov, USASpending, Grants.gov, the open web, a third-party model API); false when it reads only Mindy's stored copy of public records (Postgres tables or Mindy's BigQuery warehouse).
